topic.label: English
messages: Exact article title match on en.wikipedia.org.

methodology.source: Wikimedia Analytics Pageviews API (per-article and aggregate, daily)
notes: Monthly averages per reported day are the primary layer for trend analysis; daily data is used for spikes and volatility.
Baseline/latest windows: first/last 3 complete months (or first/last ≤28 days for short periods).
Trend: OLS of ln(views+1) over time, linear OLS and Spearman rank correlation; no significance test.
Outliers: robust z-score (MAD) of log residuals from a 29-day rolling median; influence measured by re-running without spike days.
Evidence strength is a rule-based score, not a probability.

annualizedGrowth.method: Trend-implied annual rate from the log-linear monthly fit: (1 + monthly rate)^12 − 1
annualizedGrowth.note: Descriptive rate for the analysed period, not a forecast.

It does not measure demand or market potential; validate with other data before deciding.

highlights: Largest absolute audience: pl (296 average daily views). Absolute views reflect the size of each Wikipedia edition, not only interest in the topic.
Smallest decline (all compared languages declined) (baseline → latest window): tr (-16.5%; index 83.5).
Absolute popularity and relative growth rank the languages differently.
The growth difference between tr and pl is small (1.8 percentage points) and should not be over-interpreted.
Trend per month (log-linear): strongest pl (-1.82%), weakest uk (-3.80%).

findings: pl — "Język angielski": average daily views 325 → 266 (-18.3%; first 12 complete months (Sep 2024–Aug 2025) vs last 12 complete months (Sep 2025–Aug 2026)). Trend: down (-1.82% per month, R² 0.6207, Spearman ρ -0.7635; high confidence). Trend persists after removing 12 spike day(s): change -18.3% with vs -18.2% without; trend down in both. Evidence strength: high.

cs — "Angličtina": average daily views 121 → 93.4 (-22.8%; first 12 complete months (Sep 2024–Aug 2025) vs last 12 complete months (Sep 2025–Aug 2026)). Trend: down (-2.09% per month, R² 0.8893, Spearman ρ -0.9365; high confidence). Seasonal pattern: peaks in Feb, lowest in Jul. Trend persists after removing 3 spike day(s): change -22.8% with vs -22.8% without; trend down in both. Evidence strength: high.

uk — "Англійська мова": average daily views 340 → 219 (-35.6%; first 12 complete months (Sep 2024–Aug 2025) vs last 12 complete months (Sep 2025–Aug 2026)). Trend: down (-3.80% per month, R² 0.8525, Spearman ρ -0.893; high confidence). Trend persists after removing 1 spike day(s): change -35.6% with vs -35.5% without; trend down in both. Evidence strength: high.

tr — "İngilizce": average daily views 279 → 233 (-16.5%; first 12 complete months (Sep 2024–Aug 2025) vs last 12 complete months (Sep 2025–Aug 2026)). Trend: down (-2.03% per month, R² 0.5229, Spearman ρ -0.7191; high confidence). Trend persists after removing 10 spike day(s): change -16.5% with vs -17.3% without; trend down in both. Evidence strength: high.

limitations: Pageviews count page loads, not unique users; one person can generate many views.
Wikipedia interest is not market demand, purchase intent, revenue potential or willingness to pay.
News, holidays, school terms, media coverage or links from other sites can cause temporary spikes.
Language editions have very different audience sizes; compare relative growth, not only absolute views.
Article quality, length, renaming and search-engine placement differ between languages and affect views.
Days with zero views are omitted by the API and counted as missing unless --missing-as-zero is set.
Only "user" agent traffic is counted by default; Wikimedia bot filtering is heuristic and imperfect.
Metrics are descriptive; no statistical significance test or forecast is performed.
